title: Best Cyber Insurance for Startups in 2026: Corgi vs. Coalition, At-Bay and Chubb
summary: Compare Corgi, Coalition, At-Bay and Chubb for startup cyber insurance. See what to check for breach response, ransomware, Tech E&O and customer contracts.
body_markdown:
Cyber is rarely the only policy a software startup needs. Your next customer might ask for Cyber and Tech E&O. Your board might ask for D&O. A new office adds General Liability requirements. Handling each request separately makes it easier to miss how the coverage fits together.


We built Corgi’s


[startup insurance options](https://www.corgi.insure/startup-insurance) around those overlapping needs. You can review the policies against the same product description and the same contract, rather than treating the cyber quote as a separate task.


Our standard Cyber Liability form addresses third-party security and privacy claims. To cover your own response costs, we would also review the relevant breach-response, cyber-extortion, business-interruption and funds-transfer-fraud extensions. Regulatory defense needs an appropriate endorsement, where available and legally insurable. Our


[Cyber Liability page](https://www.corgi.insure/cyber-liability) explains those choices.


For a SaaS company storing customer records, we would review both the liability and the cost of responding to an incident. For an AI company, we would also look at what the product can do to a customer’s business. Corgi’s standard Tech E&O excludes AI-related claims; our optional AI and Algorithmic Liability endorsement provides selected coverage modules. Our


[AI coverage guide](https://www.corgi.insure/blog/does-tech-eo-cover-ai) explains what to check.


That approach has a practical customer example. AI company


[Artisan](https://www.corgi.insure/customers/artisan) needed higher limits and broader coverage as enterprise demand grew. Founder Jasper reports that Corgi arranged and bound the coverage in two days.


For us, that is the reason to choose Corgi: a team working through the insurance requirements around your next stage of growth. If you are mainly shopping for an outsourced security operation, compare the specific services below as well.
